name: Gallows Furnace

detectability.signature: Raw hyperspace radiation screaming across every band; hulls within a million kilometers glow faintly blue from ionization

proximity: Power systems surge and capacitors rupture across the grid
Sensors white out under cascading interference
contact: Hull ionization ignites external coatings, antennas, and any exposed propellant
Subspace bleed-through begins transmuting exposed matter into unstable higher-dimensional states
prolonged_exposure: Crew matter destabilizes as bleed energy saturates the vessel at the quantum level
Total energetic dissolution — no wreckage remains to recover

phenomena: Visible plasma discharge arcs leaping between debris fields
Power systems overloading or draining without cause
Hull ionization and corona effects on nearby vessels
opportunities: Energy harvesting potential from the bleed interface
Data valuable to scientific institutions studying higher dimensions
known_incidents: The battlecruiser Vantage overloaded her own reactor in 2412 as a counter-frequency damper, shielding a survey convoy's retreat; her name heads the memorial at the perimeter monitoring station.
A harvesting consortium lost three unmanned rigs in a single expansion lurch twelve years ago; the recovered wreckage had transmuted into brittle higher-phase alloys no refinery can process.
description: Gallows Furnace burns in realspace as a ragged ellipse of blue-white fire twenty-six thousand kilometers long, a wound through which raw hyperspace bleeds into normal space. Discharge arcs leap from its boundary to anything conductive within thousands of kilometers, and the surrounding debris field glitters with the ionized remains of ships that came too close. It is visible from planetary surfaces in the outer system on clear nights.

The bleed expands in lurches — sometimes dormant for weeks, sometimes doubling its output in an afternoon — with no cycle any instrument has reliably correlated. Vessels entering the outer corona lose main power within minutes as their grids overload; those that push deeper begin to change, hull metal transmuting into brittle higher-phase alloys. Nothing that has remained inside the inner envelope for more than an hour has ever come back out.

The Furnace is not natural. Wreckage at its edge matches no known design, and radiation decay patterns date the original catastrophe to roughly three centuries ago — a failed jump experiment, most scholars believe, that tore the membrane between spaces and never healed. The battlecruiser Vantage died here in 2412 attempting to shield a survey convoy by overloading her own reactor as a counter-frequency damper.

A drone-monitoring network tracks the bleed's growth, and evacuation planning is underway for two mining stations whose orbits will fall inside the projected envelope within fifty years. Energy consortiums maintain harvesting rigs at the extreme perimeter, drawing terawatts from the discharge arcs at acceptable loss rates. Sailors call the approach lane the Gallows Run, and the name is not a metaphor.
